wiki_excerpt:
Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah (lit. 'Taarak Mehta's Inverted Spectacles') often abbreviated as TMKOC, is an Indian sitcom based on the weekly column Duniya Ne Undha Chasma by Tarak Mehta for the magazine Chitralekha. Produced by Asit Kumarr Modi, it is one of the longest-running television series in India. The series premiered on 28 July 2008 on Sony SAB and is also digitally available on SonyLIV.


Plot
The series is set in Mumbai and follows the lives of the residents of Gokuldham Co-operative Housing Society, a diverse community with people from different cultural and regional backgrounds.
Most storylines focus on an individual, a family, or sometimes the entire society as they encounter and resolve various problems. The characters frequently support one another and celebrate festivals together, highlighting their close-knit bond.
A recurring theme centers on Jethalal Champaklal Gada, who often finds himself in comical situations and troubles, with brief moments of relief before new challenges arise.

grok_lead: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah is an Indian Hindi-language sitcom television series that premiered on 28 July 2008 on Sony SAB. Created and produced by Asit Kumarr Modi under Neela Film Productions Private Limited, it draws inspiration from the weekly column "Duniya Ne Undha Chashma" by journalist Taarak Mehta, originally published in the Gujarati-Marathi magazine Chitralekha. The narrative centers on the daily routines, comedic predicaments, and interpersonal dynamics among the diverse residents of the fictional Gokuldham Co-operative Housing Society in Mumbai. As of October 2025, the series has surpassed 4,500 episodes, establishing it as one of India's longest-running scripted television programs. It has earned accolades such as the Indian Television Academy Award for Longest Running Show in 2018, reflecting its sustained viewership and cultural impact through portrayals of middle-class family life and social issues. Despite its popularity, the production has encountered notable controversies, including claims of sexual harassment, exploitative contracts, delayed payments, and a reportedly toxic work environment leveled by departing actors against producer Asit Kumarr Modi, prompting legal actions and public disputes.
